mapper.select: select OWER_PRAM_CD as highmenuid, BB.PRAM_NM AS parentname,'9' As menugrade, BB.PRAM_CD As lowmenuid,BB.PRAM_NM AS menuview,BB.PRAM_NM AS menuview, BB.SEQNO As sortseq, Case when substr(OWER_PRAM_CD,2,1) = '0' then 4 else 0 end as imageindex from XPRAM_AUTH AA, XPRAM_LIST BB where AA.PRAM_CD = BB.PRAM_CD and BB.USE_YN < '777' and AA.USER_ID = #{userId} union all select '000' as highmenuid, BB.PRAM_NM AS parentname, '0' As menugrade, BB.OWER_PRAM_CD As lowmenuid, BB.PRAM_NM AS menuview,BB.PRAM_NM AS menukornm, BB.SEQNO as sortseq, Case when substr(OWER_PRAM_CD,1,1) >= '0' then 2 else 0 end as imageindex from XPRAM_LIST BB where use_yn like '%00' union all select '000' as highmenuid, '홈화면' AS parentname, '9' As menugrade, 'Home1.fre' As lowmenuid, '홈화면' AS menuview,'홈화면' AS menukornm, 0 as sortseq, 4 imageindex Order by 1,7,4
